node.title: AQB entropy-ledger certificate soundness
node.statement: If an AQB ledger supplies certified lower bounds for shared-family entropy and certified upper bounds for all charged box, overlap, multiplicity, and quotient/fiber normalization costs, and the resulting lower bound is at least 429,645,547 bits, then aqb_shared_entropy_gain holds for that family.
node.attack_surface: interval-arithmetic soundness for entropy gain ledgers
node.falsifier: a ledger whose certified lower-minus-upper interval clears the threshold while the true net gain is below it
